name: CVaR Risk Parity (core 6)
description: Allocates so each asset contributes equally to portfolio Conditional Value-at-Risk, via the historical component-CVaR decomposition (Boudt, Peterson & Croux 2008). Budgets tail risk equally across assets. Distinct from MinimumCVaR (minimizes total), RiskParity (volatility contributions) and DownsideRiskParity (semicovariance). Long-only, weights sum to 1. Core 6 universe variant.
